journal_lines: Blue-white flash in the deepslate. Stopped everything.
Vein ran to six. Took all of them.
Found it at the base of the cliff. Worth the whole trip.
Four crystals, not one. Careful work to extract all of them.
Deepslate gave way to something that caught the light differently.
Buried deep in a vein of nothing useful. Found it anyway.
Clear and hard and cold even here. Diamond.
The blue flash in the deepslate face. Every time.
Spent extra time on this face. Correct to do so.
Found it on the floor of the drop, not the wall. Unusual.
The crystal was embedded in iron pyrite. Careful extraction.
A cluster. Six stones, two faces. Worth the whole expedition.
It was behind a layer of granite. The pickaxe earned this one.
Whispered nothing to no one. Bagged it. Moved.
